Robust Foster-Haltiwanger-Krizan Productivity Decompositions

fhktools-package.Rd

fhktools provides defensive implementations of the standard Foster-Haltiwanger-Krizan (FHK) productivity decomposition. It emphasizes auditable data choices, explicit turnover interpretation, and exact accounting identity checks.

Details

The main entry points are fhk_decomposition() for one endpoint pair, fhk_adjacent() for consecutive observed periods, fhk_hierarchical() for economy-wide plus within-group results, and fhk_multi_measure() for comparable results across several productivity measures.

Author

Yu Li ylxmu1019@163.com

References

Foster, L., Haltiwanger, J., and Krizan, C. J. (2001). Aggregate productivity growth: Lessons from microeconomic evidence. In New Developments in Productivity Analysis. doi:10.3386/w6803 .
